businessDifference.conflictSummary: 旧实现用持久化 failureStreak、stale 和 lastOutcome 使已有强验证成功坐标永久失效。
businessDifference.userDecision: 永久成功坐标只增不减并全栈去重；每次任务启动创建临时工作副本，失败只消耗副本，下一次启动恢复完整永久栈。
businessDifference.cardReference: docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md#G097-NPC-成功坐标永久栈与单次启动工作副本2026-08-17

connectivity.producer: Client NPC FIFO consumer executes one Cloud candidate and reports the existing verifier outcome with exact taskRunId and scene identity.
connectivity.transport: The existing NPC_CLICK_START/POLL and outcome report contracts carry taskRunId, exact scene fields, click point and verification strength; no protocol field is added.
connectivity.consumer: Cloud NpcClickMemoryStore exclusively appends unique verified-success points, snapshots all persistent stacks once per taskRunId, and SmartClickRecognizer drains the scene working stack before visual strategies.
connectivity.ordering: new taskRunId -> snapshot all permanent scene stacks -> LIFO MEMORY candidate -> verifier failure pops only the working copy and permits next MEMORY -> working copy exhausted -> existing TOOLTIP/YELLOW/PURPLE/CTRL order; verified new coordinate appends only to permanent storage and never rewrites the current run snapshot.

proves: Permanent verified-success points and per-taskRun working copies have separate lifecycles.
Failure outcomes cannot mutate, invalidate or reorder permanent successful points.
All available working MEMORY candidates are emitted before TOOLTIP and later visual strategies.
The existing FIFO producer barrier still waits for Client verifier failure before producing the next candidate.
Task terminal unregister retires only the exact taskRun working copy.
Permanent successful coordinates remain owned by NpcClickMemoryStore and survive run cleanup.
